senses.definition: (archaic outside heraldry) Right; on the right-hand side. (In heraldry, specifically the bearer's right, which is the viewer's left.)

quotes.text: my Mothers bloud / Runs on the dexter checke, and this ſiniſter / Bounds in my fathers:

quotes.text: Displaying his dexter palm, he exclaimed that there was a hand that never took a bribe; whereupon a smart auditor cried "How about the one behind your back?"
quotes.reference: 1887, George William Foote with J. M. Wheeler, Crimes of Christianity, London: Progressive Publishing:

quotes.text: Clovis wiped the trace of Turkish coffee and the beginnings of a smile from his lips, and slowly lowered his dexter eyelid.
